name: privacy-filter
description: Fail-open PII pseudonymization for sandboxed coding-agent traffic

interface.shortDescription: Pseudonymize PII before model requests leave the host.
interface.longDescription: An opt-in host-side mitmproxy addon shared by Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, and Hermes. It keeps reversible mappings outside the sandbox and forwards original content with a local warning when sanitization fails.
defaultPrompt: Set up the host-side privacy filter for this sandbox.
